author: Dandrista
title: Looking for 2D Anime Artist for Jinx/Pokémon Project
content: LONG THREAD ALERT! I am looking for a 2D artist (or artists) specializing in the anime style, with experience drawing Jinx and Pokémon! If you are interested, please drop your VGen link! (DMs will be blocked, unless you have worked with me previously.) #vgen #VgenComm I want to share more precise details about what I’m looking for, as there were some misunderstandings regarding my request! I’ll break it down to help you better understand what I need: 1st: 2 PFPs (Profile Pictures) – Both featuring Jinx in outfits from *Pokémon Masters EX*; one with Zekrom, and the other with Jolteon. 2nd: Twitch/YouTube Banner – A single, unified banner for both channels, featuring three characters: Luna Snow, Jinx, and Goku. *Twitch Panels* – Please note: these will be illustrations, and I will resize them myself as needed. TWP1: A "Domain Expansion" (anime-style) featuring Kratos, Reze, and Link. This will include references to the various platforms where I can be followed. TWP2: Two versions of Jinx—one wearing a Goku Black-inspired outfit—set against a background themed after Discord. TWP3: "Dragon Miku" performing the iconic "Miku Beam" during a concert; this will be used to display my "Rules." TWP4: Asta (in his Devil Union form) performing a slash—reminiscent of Trunks cutting down Mecha Frieza—to be used for an "About Me" section. *Illustrations* – Here are my ideas for the illustrations, with a special focus on two that will serve as thumbnails for YouTube and Twitch: AN1: Jinx wearing a Wolverine-inspired outfit, intended for a *Wolverine*-themed series on Twitch and YouTube. AN2: Jinx peeking from behind a wall at a horde of zombies—including a zombie version of Vi—as a reference to the *Road to Veronica* series. AN3: Jinx wearing epic *Monster Hunter* armor, facing off against a Fatalis—part of a "ROAD TO FATALIS" series. **The rest are just some wild ideas I came up with, haha.** AN4: Jinx as a professor in the *Pokémon Z-A* laboratory, accompanied by a Porygon2. AN5: Jinx wearing Reze’s outfit, set in the café where Reze and Denji meet. AN6: Jinx wearing the outfit of Merlina (the final boss from *Sonic and the Black Knight*). AN7: Jinx in her Season 2 outfit, seen from behind while spray-painting graffiti, with two Pokémon (they’ll be small, though I haven’t decided which ones yet). AN8: Jinx wearing Zelda’s outfit from the *Tears of the Kingdom* (TOTK) flashback sequences. In total, there will be 8 separate illustrations. If you’ve read all of this, your chances of being chosen are even higher! If you’ve read this far, feel free to send me a DM saying, "Voy a Jinxearte, culiaaaao" (I’m going to "Jinx" you, you bastard!), along with a link to your VGEN profile. I’m counting on you all to bring my vision to life! The budget is $120–$150 for the whole project, though it’s open to negotiation. I’ll share some references that Amber put together so you can see what I’m aiming for—thanks!
